description.value: Pixwi is a BC pizza chain serving pizzas, wings, garlic bread, and potato wedges at two Lower Mainland locations, including this unit inside the Metrotown mall complex on Kingsway in Burnaby. The restaurant supports both online ordering and phone-in orders for pickup. It operates in English, Mandarin, and Cantonese, reflecting the multilingual community it serves.

The phone number 604-559-1999 for the Metrotown location appears on the website but is absent from OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website; takeout is confirmed by prominent 'CALL FOR ORDER' and 'ORDER ONLINE' prompts, and 'VEG. PIZZA' confirms a vegetarian menu option.
concerns: Website header retains template placeholder contact info ('MAIN STREET, MELBOURNE, AUSTRALIA', 'INFO@FOODKING.COM', '+11002345909') indicating the site was built on a FoodKing template and not fully customized — however, the outlet-specific addresses and phone numbers at the bottom are real BC locations.
OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the address 4500 Kingsway is in Burnaby — minor geographic tagging discrepancy.
Phone number 604-559-1999 (Metrotown) is present on the website but missing from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food pizza restaurant confirmed open by website and recent OSM check_date (2025-10-04); useful to touring cyclists seeking a quick meal near Metrotown.
